title: Reproduce and critically audit DUNL whisker event detection under disclosed periodic targets
goal: Surpass the source-paper result on the same task: Infer whisker manipulation event onsets from single-trial VPm spikes; Figure 4F compares missed and false events. Shared-kernel reconstruction is a separate output.
primary_outputs: Candidate method and outputs for the source task: Infer whisker manipulation event onsets from single-trial VPm spikes; Figure 4F compares missed and false events. Shared-kernel reconstruction is a separate output.

Source-paper comparison for Figure 4F missed-event fraction and false-event fraction at 10 ms tolerance (joint endpoint): Current code binarizes positive predictions, marks target neighborhoods within two bins, and computes hit-count/target-count and outside-neighborhood-prediction-count/prediction-count. Miss=1-min(mean_hit,1). Multi-matches count; this is not one-to-one recall or F1. Publication-to-code parity remains unverified.
success_criteria: Recover the exact Figure 4F DUNL operating point and reproduce it from the publication-aligned author route on every original eligible case.
Keep the original target, inputs, split, 10 ms neighborhood convention and aggregation; a new split, one-to-one metric, hidden schedule or response-prediction task is a separately labelled extension.
Freeze the selected method and operating point using permitted training/development feedback before a single protected final comparison under declared access and resource budgets.
Demonstrate a justified improvement in the predeclared joint miss/false comparison with appropriate uncertainty; matching the paper or reducing local reconstruction loss is insufficient.
Include the disclosed schedule-only control; algebraic recovery of programmed labels alone is not an observed full-cohort paper win or evidence of neural understanding.
The bound improvement contract must be improvement_ready and its complete same-task comparison and admission requirements must pass.
Reproduction is calibration only; reconstructing a numerical result, changing the task or split, or achieving stronger significance alone is not success.
participant_inputs: All eligible whisker spike trials, source-defined binning, units/masks, trial origin and baseline context; both arms receive 16 events, 125 ms period, 500 ms phase, and disclosed top-k16/18 policy. Preserve current default 10 neuron pairs/11 allocated channels and 30/20 split as unresolved source behavior, not final-paper truth.
